data.one_liner: A custom switch widget with configurable height, width, colors, borders, text, and toggle icons.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable switch widget for Flutter applications. Allows developers to modify dimensions, border radius, colors, toggle size, and display custom on/off text and toggle icons.
use_when: You need a switch widget with custom styling that goes beyond standard Material or Cupertino switches.
You want to display custom text or icons inside the switch toggle.
avoid_when: You strictly require platform-native switch visuals without any custom styling.
strengths: Highly customizable dimensions, colors, borders, and border radius.
Supports custom text and icons (including images and font awesome icons) inside the toggle.
weaknesses: Limited to a single custom switch widget and its variations.
No complex form state management built-in beyond the standard onToggle callback.
